params.body:
## Why

Shane puts the site into maintenance during the cutover (`php artisan down --with-secret`) and tests everything through the secret URL while the public sees the 503 page. "Everything" includes the machine-to-machine doors, and `PreventRequestsDuringMaintenance::$except` was empty: during maintenance Mollie's payment callback, Blurit's image callbacks, the whole partner API and Forge's `/up` health check all answered 503. A transport payment test would have stalled, a photo would never have finished, a portal pulling after our webhook would have got nothing, and Forge would have marked the site down.

## What

- `app/Http/Middleware/PreventRequestsDuringMaintenance.php`: five doors in `$except`, each with a comment saying who calls it and how it authenticates itself:
  - `up` (Forge health check, answers the literal "OK")
  - `mollie/webhook` (payment id only; state fetched from Mollie with the API key)
  - `blurit/status` (X-Auth-Token against `BLURIT_WEBHOOK_TOKEN`)
  - `webhook/image/*/processed` (photo id encrypted with `APP_KEY`)
  - `api/*` (Passport bearer tokens, per-dealer `X-Api-Key`, token endpoint with credentials)
  - NOT added: the WhatsApp Cloud API webhook (`whatsapp`). Its POST carries no `X-Hub-Signature-256` check (the route comment says so); a door without its own lock does not belong open while the rest is closed. Meta gets a 503 and retries.
- `tests/Feature/MaintenanceModeTest.php` (`@rule P3-12.1`): with maintenance active, an ordinary page answers 503 with `Retry-After: 60`; the five doors answer with their own auth (200, 400, 401, or Blurit's own 500 without token), never 503; `/<secret>` redirects and sets `laravel_maintenance`; the next request with that cookie passes; a forged cookie does not.
- `CUTOVER.md`: a one-screen day card at the top (the ordered commands, pointing into the existing sections), a new section 0b on maintenance mode (where the secret is printed, once per browser, which doors stay open, `artisan up` afterwards, and the warning that the Forge deploy script must not contain `artisan up`; `storage/` is shared so the flag survives a deploy), two bold warnings (use the site's PHP, merge no migration PR before step 2), and one PHP version throughout (`php8.5`, as `composer.json` and CI pin it; the document mixed 8.4 and 8.5).
- `docs/bedrijfsregels/33-p3-integraties.md`: new section P3-12 with rule R P3-12.1.
- `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-15-onderhoudsstand-sloot-elke-webhook.md`: the finding, in the new per-file layout.

## Verified

`vendor/bin/phpunit --filter='Maintenance|Health|Webhook|Rules'`: 22 tests, 70 assertions, green, against a fresh MySQL database from `mysql-schema.sql` plus the post-dump migrations. `bin/rules-coverage` exits 0.
params.title: Maintenance mode for the cutover: public sees 503, webhooks and API stay open
